title: The strict actual quotient coefficient tower and its tensor
statement: Let X be a scheme, A a commutative ring in the coefficient universe, J an ideal, and U an object of the small pro-etale site [def-sfb-adic-residue-lift-comparisons]. Put R=(completed A)|U and B_n=underline(A/J^(n+1))|U, with the actual projections and quotient maps [lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence]. Regard B_n as the rank-one B_n-module restricted to R. The quotient ring successor is R-linear because its composite with the R-projection is the preceding projection. Place these modules in degree zero to obtain a strict coefficient tower C. For any cochain complex P of R-modules, form the strict tower P tensor_R C_n using the ordered total tensor [def-weil-pbc-ringed-koszul-system], and transpose it into a complex of towers. Its nth unit is the inverse tensor right unitor followed by tensoring the actual coefficient quotient R[0] to B_n[0]. These are constructions from the specified ring maps, without any existential choice of data.

source.place: lemma-naive-completion (099M), strict coefficient tensor calculation; algebraization.tex, lemma-derived-completion-koszul (0A0E); more-algebra.tex, lemma-sequence-Koszul-complexes.

proof.text: Restrict the actual quotient coefficient modules to R and place them in degree zero. The limit projection identity gives linearity of the successor. Functor.ofOpSequence, total tensor and the functor/complex equivalence construct the tower and its transposition; the rank-one unitHomEquiv constructs the coefficient unit.
